notes.title: Fresh Weiner Update
notes.notes:
Hotdog Stand

Now own a business even sooner! Buy your very own hotdog stand right at Yum Cola Park and start swimming in those fish bucks.


 Buy the hotdog stand for $5000.00. It is much cheaper than the other businesses, helping you gain money faster.
 Sell the stand at the bank when you are done with the weiner business.
 The hotdog stand comes with an employee to take care of business and free up your time for other things.
 Keep the hotdog maker filled with cooked meat, open shop and your employee will take care of the rest.
 Use the phone to call a meat vendor for easy access to cooked meat or place a stove to cook your own meat.
 Provides a small area for placing furniture.


Gas Station

Improvements to the gas station business


 You can now hire an employee.
 The employee costs you 2% of sales.
 hiring the employee will allow you to leave the gas station property while the gas station is open.
 You will still need to keep the shelves full.
 Increased the amount customers will pay for items slightly.
 Increased the minimum amount of gas customers who drive in will get from 3$ to 20$


New Item

A new oversized parts shelf can be purchased at Grandma Sandy's Storage. Vehicle parts will not take damage when stored on the shelf. Organize and safely store your parts like never before.

Change


 Changed the reward for finishing the Lordfish mansion.
 Take less fall damage.


Fix


 Gas Staion costs $45000.00 but was listed as $90000.00
 Factory sold for half as much as it cost.

notes.title: Changes
notes.notes:
Changes


 All houses and businesses are half the original price except the campground which is quater price
 Increased the price tomato, carrot and canned goods sell for to the farm stand
 Weapons at Tylers are cheaper
 The battering ram is unlocked at Tylers at the same time as all other weapons
 You no longer need to buy 3 weapons from Tyler to progress the story
 You no longer need to retrieve the weapon from the top of the tower for Tyler to progress the story


Fix


 Opening a door with a weapon from Tyler provides an item (eg. breaking a rusty door with a rusty pipe). Items will now continue to spawn in the area where the door was every 2 - 9 mins 
 Fixed an issue when talking to Tyler the cursor disappeared
 Lordfish key is easier to interact with

notes.title: Arcade Update
notes.notes:
A New Business To Own
A new interactive business is waiting for you to open to bring endless entertainment to Fishton. With new game features and some you fondly remember, such as

 Renovate and customize before opening for business.
 New vendor with many new items.
 Call the vendor from your counter.
 Upgrade the counter to unlock new items from the vendor.
 Serve up to 16 customers at a time.
 Repair machines as needed.
 Stock and empty cash from machines.
 Manage trash to keep customers happy.
 Manage customer demand at the counter and with new machines.
 New foods to cook and sell.
 New items at Scavenger Joe.

notes.title: Mechanic Mania Update
notes.notes:
A New Business
Get yourself a functional factory today!

 Manufacture two vehicle bodies not obtainable previously.
 Manufacture vehicle parts.
 New welding mechanics.
 Unlocks new tow location.
 Purchasing unlocks new item spawns at the tent camping ground.
 Only available for purchase after opening the gate to the forest.


Two New Vehicles
The Euro Sports Car and the Heavy Truck feature higher than average top speeds and selling price. Both are only available after purchasing the new factory. 

Replaceable Wheels

 Wheels can now be removed and replaced on all vehicles.
 Wheels can only be added to axles.
 Wheels only fit the corresponding vehicle.
 Wheels have been added to loot spawns.
 Sports Car Wheels can be found at the Lord Fish Mansion only after completing that part of the storyline.
 Tims Tires sells wheels for Coupe, Hatchback, Sedan, Truck, Van and SUV.
 Tim will only replace your wheels if the vehicle has a front and rear axle.


Engine Changes
Each engine has different horsepower.

notes.title: Weekly update - April 15
notes.notes:
Bulk Item Vendor

 Bulk item vendor visits the gas station more often.
 Can now buy multiple items at a time.
 They will always offer chocolate x10, chips x10, pop x10 and 1 of 3 new items. Case of meat, case of beer or case of alcohol.
 Case of beer and case of alcohol can also be purchased at the liquor store.
 Alcohol and beer now provide higher profit when sold at your gas station.

notes.title: Weekly Update - Jan 22
notes.notes:
New Furniture Items

New Gas Station Items

A New Vendor

 Chance for a new vendor to visit your gas station while open for business.

Scavenger Joe

 Scavenger Joe has one new item for sale.


Changes

 Vendors will visit your gas station more often. (Only when open for business.)
 Furniture items which hold inventory and display shelves for the gas station can now be lifted when they contain inventory. Will result in the inventory being thrown around the area.
 Vehicle bodies found for free around the map will accumulate at a slower rate.


Fix

 Fixed issue with tow menu caused by leaving the tow menu with escape instead of the exit button.

notes.notes:
Purchase a gas station

 Interactive customers.

Make money on the side

notes.title: Weekly Update - Jan 6
notes.notes:
The original NPCs have been upgraded, bringing more personality and fresh faces to FIshton.
We are hoping this adds more originality and enhances the Fishton style.
We will continure to work on bringing more activity to the streets.

The new years eve top hat for Kit-10 is available from Scavenger Joe.

Future Updates
Starting next week the weekly updates will be on Sunday instead of Friday. Our focus will be on adding more content.

notes.title: Weekly Update - Dec 30
notes.notes:
Fishmas has ended

 Decorated trees will remain as decor items but will no longer give gifts.
 Stockings will remain as decor items but will no longer give gifts.
 Kit-10 hat is no longer free but can still be obtained from Scavenger Joe.


New furniture items

 A ladder can now be purchased at the tool shop. Get all that stuff off your roof!
 A storage chest can now be purchased at the furniture shop and the storage shop. Storage chests hold twice as much inventory as Storage cabinets.
 A furniture item can be obtained from the Lordfish mansion.


Scavenger Joe also has new items. Just in time for the new year!

 All items will be 50% off! Get them quick as the sale ends Jan. 1st.
 A new hat for Kit-10
 Party balloons
 A disco ball to get the party started.
 2 new paint colors for your vehicle.


Storage fix

 Storage chest and Storage cabinet cannot be lifted when they are holding inventory.
 If Storage chest / cabinet are holding inventory when they are destroyed due to wear over time, inventory will be thrown to the ground.

Dismantle Kit 10
If you have repaired the cat but find it annoying you now have the option to dismantle it.
Just use your wrench. You can make it sit first so you don't have to chase it around.

Cafe Job

Accept the job from Evalyn in the cafe. Bring as many dishes to the dishwasher as you can before time runs out. Bring 10 in 1 piece for max payment.

Currently Working On

 Reading at the library decreases the time it takes to use a wrench.
 Reading at the library decreases the time it takes to use a grinder.
 Reading at the library increases the amount of damage repaired when using a hammer.
 Increased rate at which tools appear at the gas stations.


Other

 Changed librarian interactions.
 Updated Journal to reflect changes to tools.
 Added more areas to find vehicle parts.

notes.title: Optimal Experience Update
notes.notes:
Replaced the settings menu.
Graphics settings can be accessed from the main menu.
Graphics and audio settings can be accessed from the pause menu in game.

Added car display to screen
Added speedometer, gas gauge, gear display and distance traveled visible in both views in vehicles.
Only visible with a dash attached to the vehicle.

Added walking sounds
Walking sound can be turned on / off from the audio settings.

Other

 Tires ware at a slower rate.
 Added chance for rusty barrier breakers to spawn at the old gas station near the start area.
 Added a recycle bin to the start area.

notes.title: Update Notes Oct 6 2022
notes.notes:
Small fixes

 Fixed known issues with racing.
 Fixed issue caused last update of not being able to drive vehicle the first time entered.
 Fixed issue of car indicating low gas after filling gas.

Trailers coming next update!

notes.title: Community Feedback Update 2
notes.notes:
Added vehicle lifts.

 Access to vehicle lift when vehicle is towed to the tire shop.
 Added vehicle lift to 2 properties that you can own.
 Access to a vehicle lift at Uncle Fish's Shop. 

Vehicle improvements.

 Car body receives less damage.
 Rust accumulates slower.
 Painting your vehicle prevents rusting.
 Lowered the cost of towing a vehicle.

Improvements to survival stats.

 Showers and bathtubs now fill cleanliness to 100%
 Sinks now fill cleanliness 70%
 Shortened the time it takes to clean with sinks, showers and bathtubs.
 All rented houses now provide a shower.
 Washing machines now fill cleanliness 100%.
 Clean buff provided from dryers now lasts longer.
 Cleanliness and rest drain slower over time.
 Painting a house, working on a vehicle and sprinting drain a small amount of cleanliness and rest.

Improvements to tools

 Higher quality grinders remove more rust per use.
 Higher quality hammers repair more damage per use.
 Decreased the cost of wrenches.

Other improvements

 Removed the really great music from the pause menu.
 Flashlights are no longer a pickup item that wear out with use. Flashlights can now be turned on anytime with Shift - L.
 More frequent car body spawns.

notes.title: Community Feedback Update 1
notes.notes:
Improvements based on your suggestions

Thank you to everyone for the great feedback.



 Decreased the time it takes to work at:
   
    Out of Towner's Bar
    Mother Falker's Pizza
    Evalyn' Best Five Star Foods
   
 Decreased time it takes to:
   
    Sleep
    Wash
    Pee
   
 Decreased amount of damage vehicle parts receive on impact.
 Slowed down rust accumulation on vehicle parts.
 Updated tool tip on the bookshelves in the library. They now indicate the prerequisite tool.
 Added Uncle Fish's Shop to the map. Unlocked at the church in the story line.
 Added Lordfish Mansion to the map. Unlocked by reading the note received after completing the 2nd floor of the library.
 Rotated the pictures in the journal to align with the map, making it easier to find needed locations.
 Increased amount of inventory slots to 15.
 Fixed issue with inventory. Can no longer pick up inventory items when your inventory is full.
 Uncle Fish's Shop now provides all of the car parts needed to get the Coupe running when following the story line.

Other


 Fixed issue with the vehicle defying gravity when opening inventory after adding certain vehicle parts to a vehicle.
 Improved sound on player damage.
 Improved sound on fueling vehicle.
